Our clientele depend on us for Transparent Pricing, Convenience and, most importantly, Customer FIRST Service! No Accidents! What this vehicle includes: Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians.   • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
Technology and Telematics

Convenience
  • Remote parking - Fit in anywhere! Remote parking system allows you to pull into or out of a space without having to be in the vehicle, simply use the remote control! It's perfect when the cars next to you are too close for you to be able open your doors. With remote parking, any spot is an open spot!
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
Technology and Telematics
  • Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.

This 2026 Chevrolet Suburban High Country delivers commanding presence and refined capability, built for those who demand both performance and premium comfort on every journey.

- 17.7" Advanced Color LCD Display with Google built-in navigation

Leather seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear outboard seats ensure comfort across all three rows. The power-folding third row and power-sliding center console provide convenient access and storage solutions for your lifestyle.

Technology integration keeps you connected without distraction. The 17.7-inch display system with Google built-in navigation offers intuitive route planning, while wireless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto means your phone connects seamlessly. The head-up display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, and the Bose audio system transforms every drive into an audio experience.

Safety and control technologies work together to protect your family. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS deliver responsive stopping power. Multiple airbags, including front and side impact protection, provide comprehensive coverage. The rear parking camera and interior camera add visibility during maneuvers and everyday driving.

This Black beauty represents the intersection of capability, comfort, and contemporary technology—a vehicle engineered for drivers who refuse to compromise. Schedule your test drive today to experience the commanding presence and refined control that only the High Country delivers.

The 2026 BMW X5 xDrive40i delivers the sophistication and performance you expect from a premium luxury SUV, combining refined engineering with thoughtful design for every journey.

- Trailer Hitch
- Tanzanite Blue II Metallic exterior
- Extended Merino Leather Upholstery in Tartufo
- Driving Assistance Professional Package with hands-free driving up to 85 mph
- Parking Assistance Package including automatic park assistant and 3D Surround View
- Premium Package with Live Cockpit Pro and harman/kardon Surround Sound System
- Climate Comfort Package with 4-Zone Automatic Climate Control
- Front and Rear Heated Seats with heated steering wheel
- Front Ventilated Seats and Multi-Contour Seats
- Remote Engine Start
- Distance Control (ACC) with Steering Assistant
- Highway Assistant Limited Term
- Lane Change Assistant
- Partial Automated Driving capability
- Active Park Distance Control

This X5 xDrive40i features a 3.0L I6 engine paired with an 8-Speed Automatic Sport transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering a balance of capability and efficiency with 23 city MPG and 27 highway MPG. The stunning Tanzanite Blue II Metallic finish complements the sophisticated interior wrapped in extended Merino leather upholstery, creating an environment of luxury and comfort for every occupant.

The Driving Assistance Professional Package represents BMW's commitment to intelligent driving technology. This suite includes Lane Change Assistant, Distance Control with Steering Assistant, and Partial Automated Driving that enables hands-free driving up to 85 mph on selected highways. With eight years of service included, these systems work seamlessly to enhance your confidence and reduce fatigue on longer drives.

Parking and maneuvering become effortless with the Parking Assistance Package. The automatic park assistant, backup assistant, and trailer assistant handle the technical challenges, while Parking View with 3D View provides comprehensive visibility around the vehicle. Combined with Active Park Distance Control, you gain precise awareness of your surroundings in any parking situation.

Your comfort is prioritized through the Climate Comfort Package, featuring 4-Zone Automatic Climate Control that allows each passenger to set their preferred temperature independently. Front and rear heated seats, ventilated front seats, and heated armrests and steering wheel ensure comfort throughout the seasons. The Premium Package adds Live Cockpit Pro, a Head-Up Display with video augmented reality, and a harman/kardon Surround Sound System that transforms your driving experience with premium audio quality.

A comprehensive array of standard features enhances your daily driving, including navigation, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, power moonroof, 20-inch V-Spoke alloy wheels, rain-sensing wipers, and rear manual side window shades. The vehicle offers multiple layers of safety with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags, along with Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension.

BMW of Peoria is proud to be a family-owned dealership and part of the respected Sam Leman Automotive Group, serving drivers since 1963. Our longstanding commitment to integrity, customer care, and exceptional vehicles continues to guide everything we do.

We invite you to visit us at 1720 W Pioneer Parkway in Peoria, IL, or call (309) 692-4840 to schedule your test drive today. We look forward to welcoming you and helping you experience the ultimate driving machine firsthand.

Audi Certified Pre-Owned Benefits:

Audi Certified Pre-Owned Limited Warranty: Provides additional limited warranty protection beyond qualifying remaining new-vehicle coverage, subject to applicable Audi CPO program terms.

125+ Point Inspection: Comprehensive inspection performed by Audi-trained technicians to ensure the vehicle meets certification standards.

Prestige Package: Adds Adaptive Air Suspension, All-Wheel Steering, massaging front seats, Head-Up Display, and premium driver assistance technology.

Luxury Package: Enhances the cabin with a Dinamica headliner and extended leather appointments for an exceptionally refined interior.

S line Black Optic Package: Features 22\ bi-color wheels, S line exterior styling, dark chrome exhaust tips, and Anthracite Audi rings.

Daytona Gray Pearl Effect Exterior: The sophisticated pearl finish highlights the Q8's sculpted bodywork and athletic SUV silhouette.

3.0-Liter TFSI Turbocharged V6: Produces 335 horsepower and 369 lb-ft of torque, delivering responsive acceleration and effortless highway performance.

quattro All-Wheel Drive: Provides confident traction and stability across changing road conditions.

8-Speed Tiptronic Transmission: Delivers smooth, responsive shifting and refined power delivery.

Adaptive Air Suspension and All-Wheel Steering: Enhance ride comfort, handling precision, and low-speed maneuverability.

Valcona/Cricket Leather Interior: Premium leather seating and sophisticated cabin appointments create an elegant driving environment.

Ventilated and Massaging Front Seats: Individual contour seating provides personalized comfort and support during extended journeys.

Heated Front and Rear Seats: Offer additional comfort during cooler weather.

Four-Zone Automatic Climate Control: Allows personalized temperature settings for passengers throughout the cabin.

Panoramic Sunroof: Features an electric sunshade and expansive glass panels that brighten the interior.

Bang & Olufsen Premium Sound System with 3D Sound: Delivers immersive audio and exceptional clarity.

Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus: Displays customizable digital instrumentation, navigation, and essential driving information.

MMI Navigation Plus: Features Audi's intuitive touch-response interface with navigation, entertainment, and smartphone integration.

Head-Up Display: Projects selected driving information onto the windshield for convenient visibility.

OLED Taillights and Matrix-Design LED Headlights: Provide distinctive Audi lighting technology and sophisticated exterior styling.

Power Soft-Closing Doors: Add convenience and refinement by gently completing door closure.

Remote Park Assist Plus: Provides additional assistance when maneuvering into and out of compatible parking spaces.

Top View Camera System: Offers multiple camera perspectives to simplify parking and low-speed maneuvering.

Adaptive Cruise Assist with Lane Guidance: Helps maintain a selected following distance and supports lane positioning during compatible driving conditions.

Audi Pre Sense Front and Side Assist: Provide forward collision warning, available automatic braking assistance, and blind-spot monitoring support.

Trailer Hitch: Adds versatility for compatible towing applications, subject to vehicle specifications.

Paired with an 8-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission and quattro All-Wheel Drive, this luxury SUV delivers strong acceleration and confident traction. Its Adaptive Air Suspension and All-Wheel Steering provide an excellent balance of athletic handling, refined comfort, and everyday versatility.

With its Daytona Gray Pearl Effect exterior, Prestige and Luxury Packages, S line Black Optic styling, and Audi Certified Pre-Owned status, this 2026 Audi Q8 offers a remarkable combination of sophistication, performance, and premium comfort.
